title: Why one man quitting crashed a $4 trillion company

scenes.say: Okay? What just happened? One man quit his job and four hundred and forty billion dollars vanished. So how does that even work?
You see, a share price isn't what a company is worth today. So it's really what people think it'll be worth in the future.
And for thirty three years, Nvidia's future was Jensen Huang. So when he left, people panicked. Experts call it key person risk.
It's like your football team losing its manager the night before the final. Same players, but everyone's suddenly nervous.
But here's the twist. The chips, the factories and the customers didn't go anywhere. So some experts aren't worried at all. Would you be?
So that's how one resignation became a four hundred and forty billion dollar wobble. And everyone asked,
